purpose: Teach: 国費/楽勝/解法/在職/使い物/引換/節減/棄権

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、国費で防犯機材を更新されてるんですね
lines.en: So the police update their crime prevention equipment with national funding.
lines.style: Conversational, observational tone. Light curiosity inflected upward at the end. Warm acknowledgment without challenge. Steady, moderate pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、簡単な事件は楽勝で解決されますね
lines.en: Simple cases get solved pretty smoothly by the police, don't they.
lines.style: Gentle agreement with a note of admiration. Slight rise in pitch on the statement-as-question. Easy, relaxed delivery—noticing something positive without making a big thing of it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、事件の解法を市民にも公開されますね
lines.en: The police share how they solve cases with the public too, I suppose.
lines.style: Thoughtful, musing quality. Slightly slower pace, turning it over. Soft ending—not a definitive statement, more an observation offered for consideration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、長く在職した警察官の経験は宝ですね
lines.en: Experience from officers who've been on the force a long time is really valuable.
lines.style: Sincere warmth here. Conviction in the voice—not performative, just genuine recognition of merit. Steady eye-contact level delivery. No rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、古い装備で使い物にならない物は処分されますね
lines.en: Old equipment that doesn't work anymore gets properly disposed of.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact nod of approval. Practical tone—acknowledging sensible process management without overstatement. Even pacing, slight emphasis on 'properly.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯ポイントの引換も導入されますね
lines.en: They've introduced a system where crime prevention points can be exchanged for things too.
lines.style: Interested, slightly pleased discovery in the voice. Pitch lifts a touch on 'exchanged'—like noticing a thoughtful addition. Moderate pace, warm undertone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不要な支出を節減されてるんですね
lines.en: The police are being careful about cutting unnecessary expenses.
lines.style: Approving nod in the delivery. Calm, even tone—not emphatic, just factual recognition of good stewardship. Slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、職員に棄権しない選挙を呼びかけられますね
lines.en: They encourage their staff not to skip voting in elections.
lines.style: Shift to slightly more formal, earnest register. Slower, more deliberate. Respect for the seriousness of civic duty. Less warmth, more gravity.
